name: pisha
description: Pisha: multi-agent Claude Code. A coordinator agent runs squads of Claude Code agents on any machine, approves their safe actions and only asks you what matters. Live web dashboard and web terminal, self-hosted server with zero dependencies.

metadata.description: Multi-agent Claude Code: a coordinator agent runs squads of Claude Code sessions across machines, with a live dashboard.

plugins.name: pisha
plugins.description: Channel that lets Claude Code sessions message each other through your self-hosted Pisha server, with one session acting as coordinator of the others. Includes pairing, allowlists and access policy (/pisha:access) and reports activity to the Pisha dashboard.
